template: e = group_zscore(winsorize(ts_backfill({factor_e}, 63), 4), industry); s = group_zscore(winsorize(ts_backfill({factor_s}, 63), 4), industry); g = group_zscore(winsorize(ts_backfill({factor_g}, 63), 4), industry); composite = multiply(add(add(e, s), g), 0.3333); imbalance = add(add(abs(subtract(e, s)), abs(subtract(e, g))), abs(subtract(s, g))); is_balanced = less(imbalance, 2.0); is_extreme = or(greater(rank(composite), 0.8), less(rank(composite), 0.2)); core = trade_when(and(is_extreme, is_balanced), signed_power(composite, 1.2), trade_when(is_extreme, multiply(-0.5, composite), 0))
idea: 极端分位筛选与内部一致性过滤。仅对综合ESG分位处于前20%或后20%的极值股票进行交易，但增加内部一致性约束：计算三维度间的绝对离差和，若超过阈值则视为结构失衡，对原极端多头信号进行反向惩罚（乘以-0.5），对空头信号维持。对于通过一致性检验的极端均衡 profile，使用signed_power进行1.2次幂变换以放大尾部优势，强化龙头/龙尾区分度。
